name: Framer
summary: AI website builder that designs and publishes sites on a visual canvas with CMS, SEO and hosting built in.
description: No-code website builder with a freeform visual canvas: generate editable pages with AI agents, then publish with built-in CMS, hosting, localization, SEO and analytics. Framer Skills turn design-system, content and SEO rules into reusable instructions for the agent, and external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) can work on canvas content, components and CMS. A marketplace adds website templates, components, plugins and vectors.
contains: free plan with 500 AI credits and 1 GB bandwidth; Basic $10/mo, Pro $30/mo
AI agents plus external agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex
Framer Skills for reusable agent instructions
marketplace with templates, components, plugins and vectors
CMS, localization, A/B testing, staging and branching
publishes server-rendered HTML with sitemaps and llms.txt support
